title: AI at inflection point, future belongs to those who reinvent: HCLTech CEO
description:
As artificial intelligence reshapes the technology industry, HCL Technologies (HCLTech) CEO and Managing Director C Vijayakumar has said the sector has reached another "inflection point" with AI, and that the future belongs not necessarily to the largest, but those willing to keep reinventing themselves.
He made the remarks in a LinkedIn post marking ten years since he took charge of the IT services major.
Vijayakumar described a decade as a long time in the technology industry, during which industries have been reinvented, business models disrupted, and the boundaries of what is possible have shifted repeatedly.
Looking ahead, he tied the company's path directly to the AI moment.
"Today as AI reshapes our industry, we are once again at an inflection point," he wrote.
He added that his firm belief has been that the future belongs not necessarily to the biggest, but to those willing to continually reinvent themselves.
